scope: Proposition 2.4 (Projection on a flat torus) of the manuscript “Prefix Instructions and Incompressible Flows” (preprints/Prefix-Instructions-and-Incompressible-Flows-September-27-2026/manuscript.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 376 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 8cd581420ec9967a), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 6. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: An effective smooth mean-zero force g on T3 L has an effective mean-zero potential ϕ satisfying ∆ϕ = div g. Replacing (g, p) by (g − ∇ϕ, p − ϕ) preserves velocity and makes the force solenoidal. Uniform mixed-derivative bounds, temporal L2 bounds of their spatial suprema, and separately imposed time periodicity, eventual stationarity, or orderwise decay bounds are preserved.
